name: idea generation flow — genre then mood then prompts

payload.text: What genre are you writing in?

Here are 3 prompts to spark your writing:

1. Describe the moment sunlight hits a dewdrop — in exactly eight lines.

2. Write a sonnet where every line starts with a different color.

3. Capture the feeling of dancing alone in your kitchen — no more than 12 lines.

Tap another genre to try again, or go back to the menu.
